div.head: Af 33
div.ab: XXX. Gif hwa oðerne godborges oncunne ⁊ tion wille, ðæt he hwylcne ne gelæste ðara ðe he him gesealde, agife þone foráþ on feower ciricum; ond se oðer, gif he hine treowan wille, on XII ciricum do þæt.

XXX. Gif hwa oðerne godborges oncunne ⁊ tion wille, þæt he hwelcne ne gelæste ðara ðe he him gesealde, agife þone foreað on feower ciricum, ⁊ se oðer, gif he hine treowan wille, in XII ciricum dó he ðæt.

Si quis alium godborghes oncunne (alii Dei plegium intemptet) et compellare uelit, quod ei aliquod ipsorum non compleuerit, preiuret hoc in quattuor ecclesiis; et si alius se purgare uelit, in duodecim ecclesiis hoc faciat.

{XXX} Gif hwa oðerne godborges oncunne ⁊ tion wille, þæt he hwelcne ne gelæste ðara ðe he him gesealde, agife þone foreað on feower ciricum, ⁊ se oðer, gif he hine treowan wille, in XII ciricum dó he ðæt.

If someone charges another [with having given] a pledge [confirmed by invocation] of God and wishes to accuse him, that he did not perform one of those things that he promised him, let [the accuser] give a preliminary oath in four churches, and the other, if he wishes to exculpate himself, let him [swear the necessary oath] in twelve churches.

If one man charges another regarding a solemn pledge given under the sanction of God, and wishes to accuse him of neglecting to perform any [one] of the promises which he has made to him, he shall pronounce the oath [of accusation] in four churches, and the other [the defendant], if he wishes to clear himself, shall do so in twelve churches.

Wenn jemand einen andern anklagt wegen eines bei Gott verbürgten [Versprechens] und bezichtigen will, dass derselbe deren eines nicht erfüllt habe, die jener [Beklagte] ihm gegeben hätte, so leiste er den [Kläger-]Voreid in vier Kirchen; und der andere [Beklagte], wenn er sich reinschwören will, thue das in 12 Kirchen.

If someone accuses another concerning a [promise] pledged by God and wishes to charge that he has not fulfilled any one of those which that [defendant] had given him, let him make the [plaintiff’s] fore-oath in four churches; and the other [the defendant], if he wishes to clear himself by oath, let him do so in 12 churches.
